items.raw_excerpt: Renewing your lease in Austria isn’t always simple – from legal time limits to rent hikes, here’s what tenants should know.
items.summary_en: Tenants in Austria need to know the rules when their lease ends. Lease extensions have legal time limits and rent can increase. This guide helps renters understand their options.

items.raw_excerpt: After the 2026 edition was subjected to political, community and commercial pressures, the Biennale of Sydney has announced a new artistic director: Singaporean curator Low Kee Hong.
items.summary_en: The Biennale of Sydney has announced a new artistic director after facing political and community pressures. Singaporean curator Low Kee Hong will lead the 2028 edition. Organizers say such challenges are now part of working in the arts.
items.summary_ko: 시드니 비엔날레는 정치적·지역 사회적 압력에 직면한 후 새로운 예술 감독을 발표했다. 싱가포르 출신 큐레이터 로우 키 홍이 2028년 행사를 이끌게 된다. 주최측은 예술계에서의 이런 도전이 이제는 일상이 되었다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Boycotts and withdrawn funding 'part and parcel' of working in arts today

items.raw_excerpt: New research analyzing jade artifacts, unearthed east of the Rocky Mountains, sheds light on vast Indigenous trade networks that once cut across pre-colonial Western Canada.
items.summary_en: New research on jade artifacts found east of the Rocky Mountains reveals ancient trade networks. These networks once spanned across Western Canada before colonial times. The study helps map these historical routes.

items.raw_excerpt: Beypore fishing harbour's renovation nears completion, enhancing infrastructure for efficient operations as fishing resumes post-trawling ban.
items.summary_en: A fishing harbour in Beypore, Kerala is being renovated. The project will improve infrastructure for fishing operations. Fishing is resuming after the trawling ban ends.

items.raw_excerpt: El joven volante azul ingresó en el segundo tiempo ante Audax Italiano luego de varias fechas sin ser citado.
items.summary_en: Young midfielder Lucas Assadi returned to play for Universidad de Chile against Audax Italiano after several games without being selected. He entered in the second half and shared his emotions about being back on the field. Assadi described his time away as tough, saying it was 'so-so'.

items.raw_excerpt: Are you getting ready for your summer holidays and trying to decide which book to take to read on the beach? We’ve got some suggestions for you. Summer House with a Swimming Pool Not to be too on the nose, but the book by famed Dutch writer Herman Koch is the perfect book for your beach bag. It brings together all of Koch’s best: unlikeable characters, an unreliable narrator, a page-turning plot and the complicated relationships between parents and children....
items.summary_en: A Dutch news site shared summer holiday book suggestions for beach readers. One top pick is 'Summer House with a Swimming Pool' by Dutch writer Herman Koch. The book features relatable family drama and keeps readers turning pages.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 뉴스 사이트가 해변에서 읽기 좋은 여름 휴가 책을 추천했다. 네덜란드 작가 헤르만 코흐의 수영장 있는 여름집이 베스트셀러로 꼽혔다. 이 책은 가족 간의 복잡한 관계와 몰입도 높은 스토리로 유명하다.
items.title_en: What books to take for your summer holiday
